capabilities: toggle collapse of the left sidebar
toggle collapse of the right sidebar
toggle collapse of both sidebars at once
extras: No default hotkeys are assigned; users must set their own in Obsidian's hotkey settings.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in commands to collapse each sidebar independently, so reclaiming screen space means going fullscreen or clicking manually.
summary: Sidebar utility that adds commands to toggle collapsing the left sidebar, right sidebar, or both sidebars.
